extracted.name: BBQ Potato Salad
extracted.description: This BBQ potato salad features hard-cooked eggs, barbecue sauce, mayonnaise, red onion, and garlic powder for a tasty variation on an American classic.
ingredient_lines: 6 large hard-cooked eggs, peeled and finely diced
salt and ground black pepper to taste
0.5 teaspoon ground paprika, or to taste
instruction_lines: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until just tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
Drain potatoes. Transfer to baking sheets; spread in a single layer. Refrigerate until cold, about 2 hours.
Place cooled potatoes in a large bowl with eggs, mayonnaise, onion, barbecue sauce, and garlic powder; season with salt and pepper. Mix until well combined. Sprinkle with paprika.
